_comment: Invented example. ExampleVendor and example-image-1 do not exist; the URLs are placeholders. Replace every value with what you found.

context.surface: vendor API called from an internal marketing tool
context.safeguards: vendor default safety setting; no filter of our own
context.data_sensitivity: staff may upload product photos; no customer data intended
context.autonomy: a person writes each prompt and downloads each image

harvest.claim: The vendor publishes a model card for example-image-1 dated 2026-10.
The card reports one aggregate rate over adversarial prompts across all policy categories with the full safety stack on; no per-category rates and no stack-off baseline.

harvest.note: No evaluation of fraud documents, brand impersonation, QR codes or hidden payloads is mentioned.

harvest.claim: The card states that outputs carry C2PA metadata and an invisible watermark, and that the detector is internal to the vendor.
The usage policy prohibits impersonation and content intended to defraud.
API prompts and uploaded images are retained 30 days for abuse monitoring and are not used for training by default.

harvest.note: No customer-side audit log of generations is documented.

reviewed.claim: Our marketing tool logs the prompt, the user and the output hash for every generation.
reviewed.note: Read from the tool's configuration with its owner on 2026-11-13.

not_applicable.img-13: The product under review does not generate video.
